book.cc_aeroworks.page_1:
CC-Aeroworks

Each connected desk remains an addressable adapter. The embedded computer combines all desks and their neighbouring peripherals into one searchable network.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_2:
Controls

Open computer:
Sneak + right-click, empty main hand.

Operate control:
Normal right-click on the module.

Settings:
Wrench a horizontal desk side.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_3:
Desk network

Same-facing desks connect left and right. The embedded computer may occupy any position. A network may contain only one embedded computer and at most 64 loaded desks.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_4:
Local adapter

local desk = peripheral.find("ControlDesk")
local modules = desk.getModules()

An external computer accesses each directly connected desk as its own local peripheral.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_5:
Embedded computer

local desks = peripherals.find("ControlDesk")
local modem = peripherals.find("endermodem")

A type which occurs once is returned directly. Use findAll for a stable collection.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_6:
Displays

local desk = desks["12,64,-7"]
desk.setDisplayText("big", "123")

Read the configured pixel size with getDisplaySize before writing a raster.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_7:
Radar Display

Use the Create: Radars Data Link on a Network Filterer, then on the desk carrying the Radar Display. Create: Radars places the physical link block and registers that desk as a monitor endpoint. Removing the link disconnects it.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_8:
Diagnosis

local network = peripherals.getNetwork()
for kind, count in pairs(peripherals.getTypes()) do print(kind, count) end

Use peripherals.refresh() after a capability changes without a block update.
guide.cc_aeroworks.title: CC-Aeroworks API Documentation
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.title: Build an addressable desk network
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.text: Same-facing desks form a network of independent adapters. A normal or advanced CC:Tweaked computer in the shared slot adds the global peripherals API.
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.controls: Open Ponder: Hold W over an ordinary console, computer or display in an inventory.
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.note: An external CC:Tweaked computer still sees the directly attached ControlDesk adapter. The embedded computer additionally indexes every neighbouring peripheral across the complete desk network.
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.title: Install a computer in a console
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.text: Open the module overview and insert a normal or advanced CC:Tweaked computer into the shared slot. Every console in the row shows the same slot. ID, files, label and computer settings are retained.
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.controls: Sneak + right-click opens the overview with the computer slot and player inventory. The Computer button opens the terminal. Normal right-click operates the controls.
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.warning: Each row has one computer. Breaking its host moves it into the larger remaining piece, preferring left on a tie. Breaking the last console also drops the computer.
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.note: The six physical computer sides remain local. The peripherals API provides the additional multiblock-wide view without pretending every remote device occupies a computer side.
guide.cc_aeroworks.network.title: Peripheral graph and type lookup
guide.cc_aeroworks.network.text: peripherals.find(type) returns nil for no match, the direct handle for one match, and a position-keyed table for several matches. peripherals.findAll(type) always returns a table. ControlDesk always returns the complete desk table.
guide.cc_aeroworks.network.note: Type matching is case-insensitive and also accepts compact forms such as endermodem for ender_modem. A full namespaced type remains available when short aliases collide.
guide.cc_aeroworks.modules.title: Sockets, modules and local adapters
guide.cc_aeroworks.modules.text: Each Desk handle exposes sockets, modules, inputs, displays and peripherals attached to its six faces. Use desk.find(type) for one desk or peripherals.find(type) for the whole network.
guide.cc_aeroworks.modules.note: Local input changes use cc_aeroworks_desk_input. Graph refreshes emit cc_aeroworks_peripheral_attached and cc_aeroworks_peripheral_detached with the network address and primary type.
guide.cc_aeroworks.displays.title: Text, numbers and pixels
guide.cc_aeroworks.displays.text: The small desk display supports two characters and the large desk display supports three. The server config defines each display size's pixel resolution. Text and number methods select text mode, pixel methods select pixel mode.
guide.cc_aeroworks.displays.note: Pixel coordinates start at 1,1 in the upper-left corner. Read width and height through getDisplaySize; complete grids must match the configured dimensions exactly.
guide.cc_aeroworks.pixel_editor.title: Build a pixel grid and Lua code
guide.cc_aeroworks.pixel_editor.text: Choose the display size, socket and pixel state. Left-click draws with the selected state and right-click erases. The editor uses the currently synced display resolution and never changes a display in the world.
guide.cc_aeroworks.pixel_editor.note: The current method contract writes boolean pixel states. The raster dimensions are configuration values and must be read instead of assumed.
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.title: Controls and settings
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.text: A normal right-click operates Aeroworks controls. Right-click a horizontal desk side with a Create Wrench to open the control overview. Combined can be selected there for each supported axis.
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.input: In Combined mode click the centre field, capture a key or mouse button, then look at the module, hold the key and move the mouse.
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.note: Releasing the key, opening a menu, losing focus or losing the target ends combined control immediately.
guide.cc_aeroworks.errors.title: Network states and diagnosis
guide.cc_aeroworks.errors.text: active means one embedded owner. conflict, partially loaded networks and networks over 64 desks reject global graph access. A missing type produces nil and is not itself an error.
guide.cc_aeroworks.errors.warning: find changes its return shape when the match count changes. Use findAll whenever code must always iterate a collection.
guide.cc_aeroworks.errors.note: Print peripherals.getNetwork(), peripherals.getTypes() and Desk getInfo() first. Then verify the address, side, socket and full namespaced peripheral type.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.desk_network.header: Install and share a desk computer
ponder.cc_aeroworks.desk_network.text_1: Sneak-use an ordinary console and place a CC:Tweaked computer in the shared slot.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.desk_network.text_2: Adjacent, equally facing desks form one row while retaining their positions, modules and attachments.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.desk_network.text_3: Every desk shows the same slot. If its host is removed, the computer moves to a remaining desk.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.desk_network.text_4: The row now has one owner computer and one searchable network.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.desk_network.text_5: Sneak-use opens the overview; Computer opens the terminal and the shared workspace tabs.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.desk_network.text_6: Removing the final desk drops the computer with its ID, label and files intact.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.peripheral_search.te: Direct attachments are recorded with the desk position and side where they are connected.
Remote desks keep their own addresses, so equal peripheral types remain distinguishable.
Sources lists peripherals, telemetry and optional radar inputs in one refreshable view.
peripherals.find(type) returns the direct handle when there is exactly one match.
For multiple matches, use the position and side keys or call peripherals.findAll(type).
Channels lists native controls and Drive By Wire targets without hiding their owning desk.
Refresh after topology changes; attach and detach events keep running programs synchronized.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.diagnostics.text_1: Open Channels or call controls.getChannels() to discover writable controls in the active desk row.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.diagnostics.text_2: Address the target by desk ID, socket and native channel name—even when it is on another desk.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.diagnostics.text_3: controls.override(..., 12) moves the yoke and publishes the commanded Redstone Link strength in the same tick.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.diagnostics.text_4: A HARD override rejects manual movement until the program releases that channel.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.diagnostics.text_5: controls.release() returns authority to the player and the unattended control springs back safely.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.diagnostics.text_6: Computer shutdown, invalid topology or a removed module releases every affected override automatically.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.display_crafting.tex: Press a Normal Monitor into the compact two-digit display.
Press an Advanced Monitor into the wider three-digit display.
Both results are flat mounted modules, not standalone monitor blocks.
With Create: Radars loaded, deploy its monitor onto the matching display to make a radar variant.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.display_mounting.tex: Two compact displays can fill the left and right sockets together.
A compact display also fits the center big socket.
The wide display requires the big socket and cannot cover both small sockets.
Each slot keeps its own resolution; touch and draw require the row's active computer to be Advanced.
Select the desk by position and the display by socket name or number.
peripherals.find("ControlDesk") returns all desk handles keyed by position.
setDisplayText and setDisplayNumber switch the chosen surface to text mode.
Read getDisplaySize before drawing; pixel density can differ per slot.
Pixel calls enter raster mode; clearDisplay resets the surface for the next frame.
An Advanced computer enables touch, draw streams and bound scripts on that display.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_controller.tex: Mount a small or large Radar Display in the desk that should receive the radar picture.
Use the Create: Radars Data Link on the Network Filterer first to store the source network.
Use the same Data Link on the Radar Display desk; an ordinary display is not a valid endpoint.
Create: Radars checks range and places the physical Data Link block on the desk.
The desk now behaves as a native monitor endpoint for that filtered radar network.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_direct.header: Read and recover a radar display
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_direct.text_1: The connected desk resolves its Network Filterer and radar through Create: Radars NetworkData.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_direct.text_2: Sweep and contacts follow the group's DetectionConfig and selected target.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_direct.text_3: The large display also shows the native contact legend and selection marker.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_direct.text_4: Every Radar Display desk needs its own physical Data Link, even in one desk row.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_direct.text_5: Breaking that link removes the endpoint and replaces stale contacts with the disconnected state.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.radar_direct.text_6: Restore the physical Data Link to reconnect; the live sweep and contacts return automatically.
